    Paths inside a line of the cover #

    The points of a line form a finite convex piece S_L (CLine.finset). Arrows between points of the line are unique (arrow_unique), directed paths of D_{S_L} are monotone along the line (path_dir), and so two paths of D_{S_L} with the same ends are equal (path_unique).
